title: 金陵五题 石头城
author: 刘禹锡

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-bleed 9:16 portrait illustration for a premium Chinese poetry reader. Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 金陵五题 石头城 — 刘禹锡
山围故国周遭在，潮打空城寂寞回。
淮水东边旧时月，夜深还过女墙来。
visualReview: 孤城旧垒、环山江潮与夜月集中上部，城郭无人而显苍凉；暖纸下部无字留白。
